title: stamina — creativity

sentences.sentence: You need stamina to be a long-distance runner.
sentences.translation: 当长跑运动员需要耐力。

sentences.sentence: Elaine has the stamina and the determination to succeed.
sentences.translation: 伊莱恩具有成功所需的毅力和决心。

sentences.translation: 弗兰克是一位很好相处的同事。

sentences.translation: 药物治疗的残留作用

sentences.sentence: I used to stroll along the beach on Sundays.
sentences.translation: 我过去常在星期天沿海滩散步。

sentences.sentence: A child may not differentiate between his imagination and the real world.
sentences.translation: 孩子也许无法区分想像与真实世界的差别。

sentences.translation: 她对于自己的成就如此缄默。

translations.translation: 教区； 教区全体居民

sentences.sentence: Father Doyle moved to a new parish.
sentences.translation: 多伊尔神父调到了新的教区。

sentences.sentence: Analyzing ideographic nature of radical is meaningful.
sentences.translation: 分析部首表意性是有意义的。

sentences.sentence: The word idiographic is not to be confused with ideographic, which is the adjective formed from ideogram .
sentences.translation: 不要把研究特殊性的一词与表意符号的一词混淆，后者是衍生于表意符号的形容词。

sentences.sentence: Novels of expressionism, existentialism, absurdism and black humor all emphasize the authors' feelings and understandings of society and life, and they all obviously "ideographic".
sentences.translation: 表现主义小说、存在主义小说、荒诞派小说和黑色幽默小说等着重表现作者对社会人生的感受和解悟，具有明显的“表意性”。

sentences.sentence: A second excavation, in 1985, lasted a year and was cut short for technical reasons.
sentences.translation: 第二次挖掘是在1985年，因为技术原因持续了一年就突然停止了。

sentences.sentence: Blue flags define the excavation perimeter, while yellow ones mark the location of fossils or stone tools.
sentences.translation: 蓝旗用来显示发掘地的周长，而黄旗用来标明发掘出化石或石制工具的地点。

sentences.sentence: What have learnt from this excavation? Two thousand years ago they had swords and how much did this cost?
sentences.translation: 这次挖掘有何收获？两千年前他们就会铸剑了？铸造这把剑要消耗多少材料？

phrases.translation: 等级结构，分层结构；层次组织

sentences.sentence: ...the traditional hierarchical system of military organization.
sentences.translation: …军事组织内的传统等级制度。

sentences.sentence: She pulled the garment on and zipped it up.
sentences.translation: 她穿上衣服并拉好拉链。

sentences.sentence: The study has also been cited as compelling evidence for screening by the patient advocacy group Lung Cancer Alliance.
sentences.translation: 此研究已经被肺癌联盟的拥护此筛查方案的病人群体作为一种强有力的证据所引用。

translations.translation: 排放； 释放； 解雇

phrases.translation: 局部放电；部分放电；部份履行
电火花加工；[电]放电机械制作
放电过程；放电作用；排出过程

sentences.sentence: Hospitals now tend to discharge patients earlier than in the past.
sentences.translation: 与过去相比，现在医院更趋向于让病人早些出院。

sentences.sentence: a special diet that excludes dairy products
sentences.translation: 不包含奶制品的特别食谱

sentences.sentence: The judges decided to exclude evidence which had been unfairly attained.
sentences.translation: 法官裁决不接纳以不正当手段获取的证据。

sentences.sentence: Home visits when the meet again tears demobilization yes, yes right mother's thoughts.
sentences.translation: 探家复员时重逢的泪水是，是对母亲的思念。

sentences.sentence: Experience with demobilization and rehabilitation programs shows that young combatants can reconstruct their lives with job training and also medical and psychological support.
sentences.translation: 复员和自新计划的经验表明，少年兵可以通过职业培训以及医疗和心理支持，重新构建他们的生活。

sentences.sentence: Other sources of extra-budgetary income include funds from the central government and local governments for defense mobilization preparations, conscription, and demobilization.
sentences.translation: 其他预算外进项来源包括来自中央和地方用于防卫动员的准备工作、征兵以及复员安排的资金。

sentences.sentence: Despite strong criticism , the new system is still in place.
sentences.translation: 尽管遭到了猛烈的批评，新制度依然原封不动。

sentences.sentence: There has been widespread criticism of the decision.
sentences.translation: 这一决定受到了普遍的批评。

sentences.sentence: We try to give students constructive criticism .
sentences.translation: 我们设法对学生提出有建设性的批评。

sentences.sentence: Another criticism levelled at him was that his teaching methods were old-fashioned.
sentences.translation: 还有一个针对他的批评是，他的教学方法已经过时。

sentences.sentence: The government’s economic strategy has attracted a lot of criticism .
sentences.translation: 政府的经济政策招致了大量的批评。

sentences.sentence: You must learn to accept criticism .
sentences.translation: 你必须学会接受批评。

sentences.sentence: Many employees find it hard to take even mild criticism .
sentences.translation: 有许多员工甚至连轻微的批评也很难接受。

sentences.sentence: His actions provoked severe criticism from civil rights groups.
sentences.translation: 他的行为招致了民权组织的严厉批评。

sentences.sentence: the storm of criticism that followed his announcement
sentences.translation: 他的声明引来的批评浪潮

sentences.sentence: The geologist found many uncovered fossils in the valley.
sentences.translation: 在那山谷里，地质学家发现了许多裸露的化石。

sentences.sentence: The power of this tool of the geologist has not been exploited.
sentences.translation: 地质学家的这种工具的威力尚未得到发挥。

sentences.sentence: Well, replied the guide, a geologist came by here and told me these bones were one hundred million years old, and that was exactly three years ago.
sentences.translation: 哦，向导回答道，一个地质学家来过这儿，他告诉我说这些化石有十亿年了，再加上那是整整三年前的事了。

sentences.sentence: artistic creativity
sentences.translation: 艺术创造力

sentences.sentence: Teachers have been attacked for stifling creativity in their pupils.
sentences.translation: 教师被批评压抑了学生的创造力。

sentences.sentence: Editors complain about the lack of creativity in the ideas put to them.
sentences.translation: 编辑们抱怨说交给他们的选题缺乏创意。

text:
英语词汇 · GMAT · 第 283 单元

stamina
音标：英 /'stæmɪnə/  美 /stæmənə/
n.  耐力； 持久力
例句：You need stamina to be a long-distance runner.
当长跑运动员需要耐力。
例句：Elaine has the stamina and the determination to succeed.
伊莱恩具有成功所需的毅力和决心。

chaise
音标：英 /ʃeɪz/  美 /ʃez/
n.  两轮轻便马车

congenial
音标：英 /kən'dʒiːniəl/  美 /kən'dʒinɪəl/
adj.  舒适的
例句：Frank was a very congenial colleague.
弗兰克是一位很好相处的同事。

residual
音标：英 /'rɪzɪdʒuəl/  美 /rɪ'zɪdʒuəl/
adj.  残余的， 剩余的
短语：residual stress — 剩余应力
短语：residual oil — 渣油，残油
短语：residual strength — 残余强度，剩余强度
短语：residual heat — 余热，残热；剩余热
短语：residual current — 剩余电流
短语：residual error — 残留误差；漏检故障
短语：residual energy — 残余能量
短语：residual chlorine — 余氯，残留氯
短语：residual sugar — 剩余糖分；香槟酒甜度；残留糖
短语：residual claim — 剩余权益；[经]剩余索偿权
短语：residual gas — 残余气体
短语：residual amount — 残留量；余额
短语：residual water — 残留水，残余水
短语：residual value — 剩余价值；残值
短语：residual method — 剩磁法；余值法
短语：residual resistance — [物]残余电阻
短语：residual income — 剩余收益，剩余所得
短语：residual soil — 残积土；原积土壤
短语：residual vibration — 剩余振动
短语：residual voltage — 残余电压
例句：the residual effects of drug treatment
药物治疗的残留作用

compensatorily
音标：英 /kəm'pensətɔːrili/
adv.  补偿性地

stroll
音标：英 /stroul/  美 /strol/
v&n.  闲逛， 散步
例句：I used to stroll along the beach on Sundays.
我过去常在星期天沿海滩散步。

differentiate
音标：英 /ˌdɪfə'renʃieɪt/  美 /,dɪfə'rɛnʃɪet/
v.  区别； 【生】分化
短语：differentiate from — 将…区别开来
例句：A child may not differentiate between his imagination and the real world.
孩子也许无法区分想像与真实世界的差别。

reticent
音标：英 /'retɪsnt/  美 /'rɛtɪsnt/
adj.  缄默的
例句：She is so reticent about her achievements.
她对于自己的成就如此缄默。

parish
音标：英 /'pærɪʃ/  美 /'pærɪʃ/
n.  教区； 教区全体居民
例句：Father Doyle moved to a new parish.
多伊尔神父调到了新的教区。

ideographic
音标：英 /ˌɪdɪə'græfɪk/  美 /,ɪdɪə'græfɪk/
adj.  表意文字的
例句：Analyzing ideographic nature of radical is meaningful.
分析部首表意性是有意义的。
例句：The word idiographic is not to be confused with ideographic, which is the adjective formed from ideogram .
不要把研究特殊性的一词与表意符号的一词混淆，后者是衍生于表意符号的形容词。
例句：Novels of expressionism, existentialism, absurdism and black humor all emphasize the authors' feelings and understandings of society and life, and they all obviously "ideographic".
表现主义小说、存在主义小说、荒诞派小说和黑色幽默小说等着重表现作者对社会人生的感受和解悟，具有明显的“表意性”。

excavation
音标：英 /ˌekskə'veɪʃn/  美 /,ɛkskə'veʃən/
n.  挖掘
短语：deep excavation — 深挖[工]
短语：underground excavation — 地下挖掘
短语：excavation work — 挖土工程
短语：rock excavation — 岩石开挖，开采岩石
短语：excavation depth — 挖掘深度
短语：earth excavation — 挖土工程；土方开挖
例句：A second excavation, in 1985, lasted a year and was cut short for technical reasons.
第二次挖掘是在1985年，因为技术原因持续了一年就突然停止了。
例句：Blue flags define the excavation perimeter, while yellow ones mark the location of fossils or stone tools.
蓝旗用来显示发掘地的周长，而黄旗用来标明发掘出化石或石制工具的地点。
例句：What have learnt from this excavation? Two thousand years ago they had swords and how much did this cost?
这次挖掘有何收获？两千年前他们就会铸剑了？铸造这把剑要消耗多少材料？

hierarchical
音标：英 /ˌhaɪə'rɑːrkɪkl/  美 /,haɪə'rɑrkɪkl/
adj.  分层的； 等级的
短语：hierarchical structure — 分级结构，层级结构
短语：hierarchical clustering — 分级群聚
短语：hierarchical model — 分层模型；层级模型
短语：hierarchical control — 分级控制；阶层控制
短语：hierarchical cluster analysis — 层序聚类分析
短语：hierarchical network — [计]分级网络；阶层式网路
短语：hierarchical organization — 等级结构，分层结构；层次组织
短语：hierarchical design — 分层设计
短语：hierarchical planning — 分级规划；递阶规划
例句：...the traditional hierarchical system of military organization.
…军事组织内的传统等级制度。

garment
音标：英 /'gɑːrmənt/  美 /'gɑrmənt/
n.  衣服， 外衣
短语：garment industry — 制衣业；成衣业
短语：garment factory — 服装厂，成衣工厂
短语：garment leather — 衣服革
短语：garment design — 衣服设计
短语：fur garment — 裘皮服装
短语：garment bag — 保护衣服用的塑胶套
短语：silk garment — 丝绸服装；绸衣
例句：She pulled the garment on and zipped it up.
她穿上衣服并拉好拉链。

advocacy
音标：英 /'ædvəkəsi/  美 /'ædvəkəsi/
n.  拥护， 支持
例句：The study has also been cited as compelling evidence for screening by the patient advocacy group Lung Cancer Alliance.
此研究已经被肺癌联盟的拥护此筛查方案的病人群体作为一种强有力的证据所引用。

discharge
音标：英 /dɪs'tʃɑːrdʒ; 'dɪstʃɑːrdʒ/  美 /dɪs'tʃɑrdʒ/
v&n.  排放； 释放； 解雇
短语：discharge of — v. 卸下
短语：discharge standard — 排放标准
短语：partial discharge — 局部放电；部分放电；部份履行
短语：electrical discharge machining — 电火花加工；[电]放电机械制作
短语：pollutant discharge — 污染物排放
短语：water discharge — 排水；排水量
短语：gas discharge — 气体放电
短语：glow discharge — 辉光放电
短语：discharge from — 解雇；释放
短语：discharge capacity — 放电容量；排流能力
短语：corona discharge — 电晕放电
短语：electric discharge — 放电
短语：zero discharge — 零排放；无出料；空转
短语：flood discharge — 泄洪；洪水流量
短语：pollution discharge — 排污
短语：electrostatic discharge — 静电放电
短语：arc discharge — 弧放电
短语：discharge process — 放电过程；放电作用；排出过程
短语：discharge valve — 卸料阀；排出阀
短语：after discharge — 后放；后续放电
例句：Hospitals now tend to discharge patients earlier than in the past.
与过去相比，现在医院更趋向于让病人早些出院。

exclude
音标：英 /ɪk'skluːd/  美 /ɪk'sklʊd/
v.  排斥， 排除
例句：a special diet that excludes dairy products
不包含奶制品的特别食谱
例句：The judges decided to exclude evidence which had been unfairly attained.
法官裁决不接纳以不正当手段获取的证据。

demobilization
音标：英 /dɪˌmoubələ'zeɪʃn/
n.  遣散； 复员
例句：Home visits when the meet again tears demobilization yes, yes right mother's thoughts.
探家复员时重逢的泪水是，是对母亲的思念。
例句：Experience with demobilization and rehabilitation programs shows that young combatants can reconstruct their lives with job training and also medical and psychological support.
复员和自新计划的经验表明，少年兵可以通过职业培训以及医疗和心理支持，重新构建他们的生活。
例句：Other sources of extra-budgetary income include funds from the central government and local governments for defense mobilization preparations, conscription, and demobilization.
其他预算外进项来源包括来自中央和地方用于防卫动员的准备工作、征兵以及复员安排的资金。

criticism
音标：英 /'krɪtɪsɪzəm/  美 /'krɪtə'sɪzəm/
n.  批评； 评论
短语：literary criticism — n. 文艺评论
短语：textual criticism — 校勘；考订；版本鉴定
短语：new criticism — 新批评主义
短语：come under heavy criticism — 遭到严厉的批评
短语：adverse criticism — 反向批评；逆向评论
短语：criticism and praise — 批评和赞扬
例句：Despite strong criticism , the new system is still in place.
尽管遭到了猛烈的批评，新制度依然原封不动。
例句：There has been widespread criticism of the decision.
这一决定受到了普遍的批评。
例句：We try to give students constructive criticism .
我们设法对学生提出有建设性的批评。
例句：Another criticism levelled at him was that his teaching methods were old-fashioned.
还有一个针对他的批评是，他的教学方法已经过时。
例句：The government’s economic strategy has attracted a lot of criticism .
政府的经济政策招致了大量的批评。
例句：You must learn to accept criticism .
你必须学会接受批评。
例句：Many employees find it hard to take even mild criticism .
有许多员工甚至连轻微的批评也很难接受。
例句：His actions provoked severe criticism from civil rights groups.
他的行为招致了民权组织的严厉批评。
例句：the storm of criticism that followed his announcement
他的声明引来的批评浪潮

geologist
音标：英 /dʒi'ɑːlədʒɪst/  美 /dʒɪ'ɑlədʒɪst/
n.  地质学家
例句：The geologist found many uncovered fossils in the valley.
在那山谷里，地质学家发现了许多裸露的化石。
例句：The power of this tool of the geologist has not been exploited.
地质学家的这种工具的威力尚未得到发挥。
例句：Well, replied the guide, a geologist came by here and told me these bones were one hundred million years old, and that was exactly three years ago.
哦，向导回答道，一个地质学家来过这儿，他告诉我说这些化石有十亿年了，再加上那是整整三年前的事了。

creativity
音标：英 /ˌkriːeɪ'tɪvəti/  美 /,krie'tɪvəti/
n.  创造力， 创作力
例句：artistic creativity
艺术创造力
例句：Teachers have been attacked for stifling creativity in their pupils.
教师被批评压抑了学生的创造力。
例句：Editors complain about the lack of creativity in the ideas put to them.
编辑们抱怨说交给他们的选题缺乏创意。
